items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: I heard blues singers there. Like Champion Jack Dupree... These people I heard there.

ctx.x: I know people from Sweden who have been there, I know I've heard them before. And I heard blues singers there. Like Champion Jack Dupree, who is from New Orleans too. Uh-huh. And I heard Memphis Slim from Chicago. And, uh, who else? Another piano player. Curtis Jones, also. These people I heard there.
Yeah, well he played with that Moguli Jospin band.
